english.title: Publicly advertise a reward for the return of stolen / lost goods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) publicly advertised a reward for the return of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), which had been stolen or lost and in the said advertisement used words to the effect that

(A)_[no questions would be asked]_
(B)_[the person producing the said goods would be safe from apprehension or enquiry]_
(C)_[any money paid for the purchase of the said goods would be repaid]_
(D)_[any money advanced by way of loan on the said goods would be repaid]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY - WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS APPLIES..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23 of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
publicly advertised a reward
for return of goods stolen / lost
words implying no questions asked OR
person producing safe from apprehension / enquiry OR
money repaid OR
loan repaid

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Hysbysebu'n gyhoeddus gwobr ar gyfer dychwelyd nwyddau wedi'u dwyn / ar goll
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi hysbysebu'n gyhoeddus, gwobr ar gyfer dychwelyd nwyddau, sef **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), a oedd wedi'u dwyn neu oedd ar goll, a defnyddiwyd yn yr hysbyseb hwnnw, eiriau a oedd yn rhoi'r argraff

(A)_[na ofynnid unrhyw gwestiynau]_
(B)_[y byddai'r unigolyn a fyddai'n dychwelyd y cyfryw eiddo yn ddiogel ac na ofynnir unrhyw gwestiynau iddynt]_
(C)_[y telir arian yn ôl os talwyd am y cyfryw eiddo]_
(D)_[yr ad-delir unrhyw arian a gafwyd ar ffurf benthyciad er mwyn talu am y cyfryw eiddo]_
(E)_[**(..SPECIFY - WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS APPLIES..)]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 23 Deddf Dwyn 1968.
